prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, vertical portrait-orientation close-up beauty portrait of THREE women arranged in a triangle. Two women (#1 on the left and #3 on the right) stand in front side by side, shoulders touching, leaning very slightly toward the centre, and the third woman (#2) stands directly behind them, centred between the two front women and raised about a hand's breadth higher, so that her whole face, jaw and neck are fully visible above and between the two front heads, her chin clearing the crowns of their heads. All three face the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of the back woman's head down to the line of the front women's shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them. Every face is large and sharp. All of them stand together in one single shared scene in front of the same continuous background, and this is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, not a collage: the women overlap slightly in depth and the background runs unbroken behind all of them. All three women share the same surgically sculpted lips, eyes and nose, pushed to the absolute extreme: their lips are the absolute extreme of 'Russian lips', a cartoon-doll mouth made real: the upper lip pressing right up against the base of her nose and the lower lip reaching the very tip of her chin, so the whole mouth is one enormous, glossy, perfectly symmetrical dome and by far the biggest thing on her face; their eyes are pure fantasy eyes about ten times their natural length and far taller and rounder than normal: the inner corners fully opened with the small pink inner corners visible, the outer corners sweeping across her temples, past her ears and into the hairline, two colossal almond-shaped eyes each with a huge round iris and a clean sweep of white on both sides, symmetrical and graceful, a fine eyeliner in the colour of her makeup ending in a long point swept up above each ear, in very large doll-eye contact lenses with a glossy shine, a round natural pupil and bright catchlights; their nose is the most extreme surgical nose imaginable: an extremely tall, knife-edged bridge, a long needle-pointed tip projecting far forward and tilted slightly upward, and nostril wings pinched to thin slit-like nostrils; and the outline of each woman's face (forehead, cheeks, jawline and chin) is her own, a different silhouette for every woman, described in her own paragraph below. Each of them keeps her own makeup, lip colour, lens colour, hair and piercings as described below, and the three faces are three different women who simply share these extreme lips, eyes and nose.

Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, an uneven natural skin tone with a faint flush across the cheeks and around the nostrils, tiny visible pores on the nose and chin and fine natural vertical lines in the lips, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips, eyes and nose are all sculpted to the extreme in the shared way described above (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here); her facial contour is her own and overrides the shared lower face (the contour described here overrides the whole outline of her face, meaning the forehead, cheeks, jawline and chin): her hair is swept back behind both ears so the entire outline of her face is clearly visible; deeply sculpted hollow cheeks: below each high, sharply defined cheekbone the cheek falls away in a deep, smooth, shadowed hollow that runs from the ear toward the corner of the mouth, so the cheekbones catch the light as bright ridges above soft dark shadows, and the lower face looks slim, lean and carved with a clearly defined jaw edge. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, never distorted, never grotesque.

#1 Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about nine in total (not counting the hanging drops), spread over every area so that no area is empty: one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the lower opening holding a huge dome-shaped bell earring as large as her palm, with rows of tiny gem and pearl drops hanging from its rim, hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the upper opening holding a large classic round hoop earring, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, never distorted, never grotesque.

#2 Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about nine in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; on each ear, one large healed opening in the earlobe holding a very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above it sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. #3: A striking adult Chinese woman — Chinese fresh natural beauty fair complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and real visible pores, mid 20s, glossy dark-brown loose waves past the shoulders, extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: smudged black raccoon eyeliner ringing the eyes, jagged black eyeshadow shards at the outer corners, thick black lower lashes, thin bleached brows, glossy black lips with a deliberately ragged edge, odd-eyed with two clearly different lenses: her left eye has a vivid violet-purple coloured contact lens with a greatly enlarged dilated pupil, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, and her right eye has a bright turquoise coloured contact lens with a greatly enlarged dilated pupil, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, the two eye colours both bright and clearly different from each other, heavy-lidded eyes under half-lowered eyelids, lips slightly parted, a sultry, alluring expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips, eyes and nose are all sculpted to the extreme in the shared way described above (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colours follow the colour plan stated at the end of this clause, replacing the lip colour of her makeup, and the finish is glossy); her facial contour is her own and overrides the shared lower face (the contour described here overrides the whole outline of her face, meaning the forehead, cheeks, jawline and chin): an upswept fox-cat face: her hair is swept back behind both ears so the entire outline of her face is clearly visible; high cheekbones that rise diagonally upward toward the outer corners of the eyes, wide-set temples, and clean straight diagonal cheek lines that run steeply downward from the cheekbones to a small, narrow, softly pointed chin, so the face reads as a wide, lifted upper half and a sharply narrowed lower half; her lips are painted in 2 different flat solid colours with crisp, straight, clean boundaries between them: the upper lip is pearl white and the lower lip is golden yellow, every block fully opaque and glossy. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, never distorted, never grotesque.

#3 Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about nine in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The face and ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones. Her lips and chin carry no piercing at all, so the shape of her lips stays completely clear and unobstructed. Her ear weights are each a different shape and a different metal among gold, bronze, iron, tin, brass, silver, copper and lead.

Ear weights, for the women who wear weights in their lobes: On each ear of every woman who wears weights, all four weights hang from her iron rings in staggered columns, each weight on its own thick chain of heavy links of the same metal as the weight, the chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid, squat, blunt lump of rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal, in the metal named in her own paragraph, at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; the last weight is as big and heavy-looking as the first, each chain pulled bar-straight and taut, the long chains hanging freely in the air, clear of the neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of the collarbones. Because the load is carried by her iron rings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; no lobe stretches long, tears or collapses or hangs down to the neck or shoulder, every head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness.

Earrings: the large earrings of the women who wear them hang freely in the air down to the level of the collarbone and no lower, and no earring of one woman hangs in front of another woman's face.

All piercings: Each woman wears only the piercings named in her own paragraph, in those places and nowhere else; on every woman the eyes, eyelids and eyebrows stay completely clear. All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar is embedded in the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface; every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden, all of them passing through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around them.

Hair: every woman's hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, jawlines and necks fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Pose: the two front women stand upright shoulder to shoulder, arms relaxed, shoulders touching and leaning very slightly toward the centre; the back woman (#2) stands upright in the gap behind them, raised so that her chin sits clearly above the crowns of the front women's heads and her shoulders show above and between theirs; all three heads are level and face the camera. The hanging ear pieces of each front woman stay in front of her own neck and shoulder, those of the back woman (#2) end no lower than the level of her chin so that they hang in clear view above the front heads, and no hanging piece of one woman hangs in front of another woman's face. They all share one single continuous background behind them, the same one for all of them, with no separate panels, no split screen, no borders and no different backgrounds behind different women. There is no dividing line between the women, and no different light, colour or background on different women.

Lighting: The background is a city street at night in the rain, blurred neon signs and car lights in teal and deep blue, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no other people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than their faces so that their faces and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from their skin tones, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. One single light setup lights everyone from the same direction with the same colour, so the shadows and highlights match on every woman. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 vertical 8K.
